description_intro: Learn how to get ChatGPT to write, explain and fix Excel formulas for you, even if you hate Excel. We cover SUMIF, SUMIFS, XLOOKUP, IF and fixing errors, with every prompt copied below.
prompts_used: My Excel sheet has Date in column A, Salesperson in B, Region in C, Product in D and Amount in E. Write a formula for the total amount for the North region.
Total for North, but only in March 2026.
Pull the price for the product in D2 from the Prices sheet, where products are in column A and prices in column B. Show 'Not found' if it's missing.
Write 'Bonus' if the amount is 10,000 or more, otherwise 'No'.
This formula shows an error. What's wrong and how do I fix it? [paste formula and error]

scenes.voiceover: Most people waste hours googling Excel formulas. Today you'll get ChatGPT to write them, explain them, and fix them when they break. Five formulas that cover most office work.

card.heading: Let AI write your Excel formulas
lines: SUMIF · SUMIFS · XLOOKUP · IF · fixing errors

scenes.voiceover: Here's the sales sheet we'll use: dates, salespeople, regions, products and amounts. The trick is to tell ChatGPT exactly what your columns are.
Prompt one. My sheet has Date in column A, Salesperson in B, Region in C, Product in D and Amount in E. Write a formula for the total amount for the North region.

card.heading: Total for one region
lines: You: Region is in column C, Amount in E. Write a formula for the total for North.

scenes.voiceover: In plain English: look down the Region column, and wherever it says North, add up the Amount. Paste it into any empty cell and there's your total.

card.heading: How SUMIF reads
lines: where to look, what to match, what to add

scenes.voiceover: Now something harder. Total for North, but only in March. This is where most people give up.

card.heading: Two conditions at once
lines: You: Total for North, but only in March 2026.
AI: Use SUMIFS, because there is more than one condition.

scenes.voiceover: ChatGPT switches to SUMIFS, with an S, because we now have more than one condition. Region is North, and the date is on or after the first of March and before the first of April.
Formula three is looking things up. Ask it to pull the price for the product in D2 from a Prices sheet, and to show Not found if it's missing.

card.heading: Look up a price
lines: You: Pull the price for the product in D2 from the Prices sheet. Show 'Not found' if it's missing.

scenes.voiceover: XLOOKUP finds the product in the Prices list and returns the price next to it. Drag it down and every row fills in. On an older Excel without XLOOKUP, just ask for the VLOOKUP version.
Four is a simple rule. Write Bonus if the amount is ten thousand or more, otherwise No.

Five is my favourite: fixing errors. When a formula shows an error, copy the formula and the error into ChatGPT and ask what's wrong. It explains the problem in plain English and gives you the fixed version.

card.heading: Fix any error
lines: You: This shows #REF!. What's wrong? [paste formula]
AI: The sheet name is missing. Here's the fixed formula...

scenes.voiceover: Three tips so it gets it right the first time. Always name your columns and their letters. Say what should happen when data is missing. And ask it to explain the formula step by step so you can check it.

card.heading: Get it right first time
lines: Say what to do when data is missing

scenes.voiceover: One warning. AI can be confidently wrong. Always test a formula on a few rows you can check by hand before you trust it with real numbers.

card.heading: Always test on a few rows

scenes.voiceover: That's five formulas: SUMIF, SUMIFS, XLOOKUP, IF, and error fixing. All the prompts are in the description. Next week, clearing a hundred emails in fifteen minutes with AI. Subscribe so you don't miss it.

lines: You: Region is in C, Amount in E. Total for North?

scenes.voiceover: Paste it in and you're done. Look down Region, wherever it says North, add up Amount.
